answer_1.quote: Our multi-table QA model, MultiTabQA, ... generates a final table as answer. ... We train a neural model to mimic a semantic parser and generate the answer. ... The model always generates a table, T_out, which can be single celled for scalar answers, single rowed or columned for list-based answers, and multiple rows and columns for tabular answers.
answer_1.outputs: tabular answers (structured tables with headers and values)

answer_2.quote: We define table exact match Accuracy (Table EM) as the percentage of predicted tables which exactly matches the target tables. ... We evaluate partial correctness with exact match of rows, columns and cells. ... Row exact match ... Column exact match ... Cell exact match ...
